instructions: 1. Students must regularly check their attendance status on AMS and also with their class coordinators. Those not having attendance as per the ordinance of MITS- DU, will not be allowed to appear in the examinations.
2. All the II year students are expected to register for mandatory Novel Engaging Courses (NEC) in III & IV semester and Skill Internship Program (Institute level) at the end of III semester.
3. From IV semester onwards, students can select “additional courses from NPTEL” to get minor specialization in allied discipline or Honours in chosen track of the parent discipline.
4. Students are expected to submit all the assignments and appear for all weekly quizzes/final quizzes as a part of continuous assessment.
5. Students must attend “Additional Classes” conducted by the faculty for clearing the doubts and discussing other academic issues, as per need.
6. For each student, it is compulsory to appear in Minor evaluations.

7. Make-up evaluation will be conducted only for those students who could not appear in minor due to some valid/bonafide reason and who have taken prior permission from the Class Coordinators & HoD. Full syllabus will be covered under Make-up evaluation.

8. Exam fees will be deposited during Registration but it does not mean that the students are eligible to appear in the major evaluations unless the requirements specified in the ordinance of MITS-DU are fulfilled.
9. Pre-Result Review (Major Evaluations): In case of any discrepancies, the students may apply for review within the specified timelines.
10. Grade Moderation: Statistical system of grading (relative grading) will be implemented for the award of grades (Except the M.E./ M.Tech Programmes);

11. Summer Semester is an optional semester, to be conducted at the end of each year to complete the backlog courses (if any) of preceding semesters evaluations and also to makeup/improve the CGPA (only if candidate has failed to score minimum CGPA of 5.0, as per the mandate requirement of the ordinance)

12. The students whose results are not declared/not eligible for year promotion are required to provisionally register with the undertaking that if they fail, their provisional registration may be treated as cancelled. Attendance during the period of provisional registration will be counted for fulfilling attendance requirements.
